archetype: one of: storefront | workshop | cafe | studio | warehouse

palette.body: #rrggbb, main wall color, HSL lightness 0.45 to 0.85
palette.trim: #rrggbb, window frames and edges, HSL lightness 0.80 to 0.97 (almost white)
palette.accent: #rrggbb, doors, awnings and details, usually the main brand color, HSL lightness 0.10 to 0.75

sign.color: #rrggbb, the text color, contrast ratio with background 4.5 or higher
sign.tagline: string, optional, 28 characters or fewer. Leave this key out if nothing fits

roof_props: 0 to 3 of: solar_panels | water_tower | rooftop_garden | vents | antenna | chimney, no repeats
ground_props: 0 to 4 of: planters | benches | bike_rack | delivery_van | pallets | cafe_tables | street_lamps, no repeats

rooms.id: string, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starts with a letter, 24 characters or fewer, unique
rooms.name: string, 26 characters or fewer
rooms.short_name: string, 14 characters or fewer, shown on the 3D label
rooms.kind: one of: finance | sales | marketing | supply | product | operations | people | custom. Only custom may appear twice
rooms.furniture: one of: desk | shelves | workbench | counter | meeting_table | drafting_table | lounge | crates
rooms.description: string, 180 characters or fewer, what the owner sees and decides in this room
tracks: 1 to 3 strings, 40 characters or fewer each, what this room keeps track of

reasoning: string, 280 characters or fewer, why this building and these rooms fit the company
